# Infinity Maths

Step-by-step binomial expansion lessons: watch the working written out, try it yourself, practise at three difficulty levels, and play revision games.

## Working on it

```sh
npm install      # once: installs esbuild, the only dependency
npm run dev      # serves src/ at http://localhost:8000; edit a file and refresh
npm run build    # bundles src/ into the single, self-contained index.html
```

**Edit files in `src/`, never `index.html`.** The root `index.html` is generated by `npm run build`: every script, stylesheet and image inlined into one file. That keeps it opening straight from disk (browsers refuse ES modules over `file://`) and hostable anywhere, such as GitHub Pages. Run the build and commit `index.html` with your change.

## Layout

```
index.html                  built app (generated)
build.mjs                   the build: esbuild bundles src/, then inlines it into index.html
src/
  index.html                page markup; links styles/index.css and main.js
  main.js                   entry point: registers the topic, then starts each part of the page
  config.js                 settings: question groups, levels, tabs, timings, storage key
  assets/                   logo (light and dark) and the browser-tab icon
  styles/
    index.css               imports the files below in cascade order (keep it)
    reset.css  theme.css  layout.css  notebook.css  pages.css  responsive.css
  utils/                    pure helpers, no knowledge of the app
    dom.js                  $, sleep, calm (reduced motion)
    random.js               ri, rnz, shuffle
    bigint.js               nCr, powers, integer roots, findN
    fraction.js             exact fractions
    format.js               numbers, powers and polynomials as HTML
    parse.js                reading typed numbers and bracket expressions
  core/                     the maths
    binomial.js             the question, every term, products with a second bracket
    answers.js              checking a typed answer
  lessons/                  turning maths into lines of working
    lesson.js               L (a line), MC / Nm (questions), newSteps
    steps.js                step sequences shared by several types
    expand.js               the full expand-and-simplify lesson
  topics/binomial/          everything specific to this topic
    index.js                imports every type file, re-exports TYPES, genQ and GAMES
    registry.js             TYPES, T() to register a type, genQ (question at a level)
    types/expand.js  find.js  unknown.js  other.js   the 18 question types, by group
    games.js                revision-game question generators
  player/                   the notebook
    notebook.js             writes lessons line by line, asks Try-it questions; openBook()
    calc-animation.js       numbers merging into the answer on calculation lines
  ui/                       one module per part of the page
    hub.js  tabs.js  learn.js  builder.js  practice.js  games.js  difficulty.js
```

## How the modules link

Every file is an ES module: it `import`s exactly the names it uses and `export`s the names other files use. Imports only point one way, so there are no circular imports:

```
main.js ─┬─► topics/binomial/index.js            (registers the question types)
         ├─► player/notebook.js                  (initNotebook)
         └─► ui/*  ─┬─► player/*  ─────────────────────────────────────► utils/*
                    └─► topics/binomial/*  ─► lessons/*  ─► core/*  ─► utils/*
                                                                      config.js is imported where needed
```

`utils/` knows nothing about the app, `core/` is just the maths, and the notebook (`player/`) works on any lesson without knowing the question types.

- `main.js` imports `topics/binomial/index.js` **first**. That runs each `types/*.js` file, and each one calls `T(id, definition)` to add its question types to the shared `TYPES` registry. The file order sets the order of types inside each group.
- `main.js` then calls each part's `init…()` in turn. `initLearn()` returns `{home}`, and `main.js` passes that to `initHub` and `initTabs` as callbacks, so the hub and tabs can reset the Learn tab without importing it.
- Screens open lessons through one function, `openBook(lesson, guided)` from `player/notebook.js`. The notebook keeps its own state (`lesson`, `busy`, `run`, …) private.
- `calc-animation.js` gets the notebook's state passed in (`combine(plan, {live, skipping, speed})`) instead of importing it, so the two player files don't import each other.
- Styles link the same way: `src/index.html` loads `styles/index.css`, which `@import`s the others. The build inlines them in that order.

## Adding a question type

Add a `T('myType', {...})` block to the right file in `topics/binomial/types/`, following its neighbours. Give it `name`, `group` (one of `GROUPS` in `config.js`), `blurb`, `text`, `build`, plus `gen(lv)` for difficulty levels and `ans` for Practice. It appears in Learn, Practice and the question form automatically.

## Adding a topic

Create `topics/<topic>/` with its own `registry.js`, types and `index.js`, add a folder button to `src/index.html`, and import the topic in `main.js`.
